notes.title: Diluvian Ultra: Awakening Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The day has finally come, as a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Boomstock2024]BOOMSTOCK[/url] event, we can announce that Diluvian Ultra's prologue called Diluvian Ultra: Awakening is launching today.

And what's more, the game is available to everyone FOR FREE!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225260/

We can't describe how happy we are to finally share what we've been working on during the past months!

If you run into any bugs or if you simply want to share your feedback, feel free to do so here on Steam or join our [url=https://discord.gg/CVvD8JP9zG]Discord[/url] server where we can chat!

And if you don't have enough, check out the rest of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Boomstock2024]BOOMSTOCK[/url] event participants, as there are many great games showing new trailers, adding new content or even launching!
